definitions.N_p2: least completion time over plays that never grow from pop 2 to pop 3 (growth-event reading; the strict pop-2 class)
definitions.N_p3_growth: least completion time over plays with a growth event whose target is >= 3, including when that growth happens on the completing step
definitions.N_p3_standing: least completion time over plays with a standing pop-3 state strictly before the completing step
definitions.pop3Helps: N_p3 < N_p2 for the corresponding N_p3 reading
definitions.pop4Note: pop 4 is forbidden in the frontier comparison; see pop4SideCheck
definitions.horizon: N2_upper(c) = 7 + ceil(c/630), the exact strict pop-2 completion time
definitions.layerDedup: exact within-layer dedup over (pop, food, prog, trained, pop3Flag)
definitions.costUnits: cost in 1/100 production units; costAxis = cost/100

envelopeGrowth.note: Envelope from one cost-free BFS with the population capped at 3. M3/M2 are max credited progress at the completing step; the first cost with N_p3 < N_p2 is exact inside the envelope horizon.

envelopeStanding.note: Envelope from one cost-free BFS with the population capped at 3. M3/M2 are max credited progress at the completing step; the first cost with N_p3 < N_p2 is exact inside the envelope horizon.
